faults.title: Incorrect VLAN Assignment: VLAN 20 Missing on Trunk
faults.explanation: VLAN 20 was excluded from the allowed trunk VLAN list on SW1 port FastEthernet0/24 connecting to SW2.
faults.impact: Guest endpoints and wireless AP clients connected to SW2 are partitioned from R1; DHCP requests fail and clients receive 169.254.x.x.
faults.evidence: switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,30,99 (VLAN 20 not allowed).
faults.remediation:
SW1(config)# interface FastEthernet0/24
SW1(config-if)# switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,99
faults.expected_result: Trunk encapsulation carries 802.1Q tag 20; guest clients receive 10.10.20.x IP leases and ping gateway 10.10.20.1.

faults.title: Missing DHCP Configuration: EMPLOYEE Pool Absent
faults.explanation: The DHCP pool for VLAN 10 (EMPLOYEE) is missing from R1 configuration.
faults.impact: Employee desktop PCs fail to acquire network settings via DHCP DORA and cannot reach the internal server or internet.
faults.evidence: DHCP pools defined on R1: ['GUEST'] (EMPLOYEE missing).
faults.remediation:
R1(config)# ip dhcp pool EMPLOYEE
R1(dhcp-config)# network 10.10.10.0 255.255.255.0
R1(dhcp-config)# default-router 10.10.10.1
R1(dhcp-config)# dns-server 10.10.30.10
faults.expected_result: R1 DHCP daemon responds to DHCPDISCOVER with DHCPOFFER in 10.10.10.0/24 range.

faults.title: Incorrect Gateway Address on Subinterface
faults.explanation: Subinterface GigabitEthernet0/0.10 is configured with IP 10.10.10.254, but the network plan and DHCP specify 10.10.10.1.
faults.impact: Employee PCs sending packets to 10.10.10.1 fail ARP resolution; inter-VLAN routing and internet connectivity break.
faults.remediation:
R1(config)# interface GigabitEthernet0/0.10
R1(config-subif)# ip address 10.10.10.1 255.255.255.0
faults.expected_result: Subinterface IP becomes 10.10.10.1; hosts successfully ping gateway and route packets.

faults.title: Missing NAT / PAT Translation Configuration
faults.explanation: R1 has no dynamic PAT overload statement linking internal branch subnets to WAN interface GigabitEthernet0/1.
faults.impact: Internal 10.10.0.0/16 packets exit to ISP without translation; ISP drops RFC 1918 private source packets.
faults.evidence: No 'ip nat inside source list ... overload' detected in configuration.
faults.remediation:
R1(config)# ip access-list standard 1
R1(config-std-nacl)# permit 10.10.0.0 0.0.255.255
R1(config)# ip nat inside source list 1 interface GigabitEthernet0/1 overload
faults.expected_result: Dynamic translations recorded in 'show ip nat translations'; outbound ping to 198.51.100.10 succeeds.

faults.title: Incorrect Guest ACL: Internal Subnet Denials Missing
faults.explanation: The Guest ACL contains a broad 'permit any' without preceding 'deny' rules for Server VLAN (10.10.30.0/24) and Management VLAN (10.10.99.0/24).
faults.impact: Severe security breach: Guests can access internal company server and switch management interfaces directly.
faults.evidence: ACL GUEST-IN permits 10.10.20.0/24 to any without blocking 10.10.30.0/24 or 10.10.99.0/24.
faults.remediation:
R1(config)# ip access-list extended GUEST-IN
R1(config-ext-nacl)# 10 deny ip 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255
R1(config-ext-nacl)# 20 deny ip 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255 10.10.99.0 0.0.0.255
R1(config-ext-nacl)# 30 permit ip 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255 any
faults.expected_result: Guest ping to 10.10.30.10 is Destination Host Unreachable; ping to 198.51.100.10 (Internet) succeeds.
